gate.Purpose: Converge shared UI/security with employee-facing/domain capabilities before browser/UAT acceptance.
gate.Required External Dependencies: EXT-0014; EXT-0016; EXT-0019 where affected capability activation applies
gate.Evidence Required: Backend authorization tests; UI state tests; Persian/RTL/Jalali checks; request/status/deep-link evidence; sensitive-data controls.
gate.Pass Condition: User-facing target capabilities are functionally integrated without widening source-domain authority.
gate.Failure Consequence: Browser verification and affected representative UAT scenarios remain blocked.
gate.Notes: Capability-by-capability emergence is allowed; this gate summarizes convergence.
